scientific_integrity: The classification is a mathematical self-reviewed claim. The finite-field tests corroborate but do not prove the all-field argument. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to five constant-coefficient universal terms on the full augmented category, ordinary tensor associator and unit constraints, and base fields; no statement for all natural transformations or arbitrary commutative base rings.
title: Characteristic-free five-term rigidity for augmented Rota–Baxter tensor products
